rules.statement: A plaintiff may recover money paid by him for the defendant's use, at the defendant's request, if the payment was made under compulsion or threat of law.
rules.supporting_quote: By English Law a plaintiff may recover money paid by him for the defendant's use, at the defendant's request. It is not enough that the plaintiff's payment benefited the defendant; it must also have been made at his request, express or implied. A request will be implied if the plaintiff has paid under compulsion, or under a threat of compulsion, of law.
